Task: Click an existing circle on the canvas to select it.
Expected Result: The clicked circle is visually distinguished (e.g., highlighted, outlined), and its properties (e.g., position, color, size, opacity) are loaded into the corresponding UI controls for viewing and editing.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
